document_data.title: Follow-up Recommendations for Carlos Mendes
document_data.content: Carlos Mendes was advised to continue with Lisinopril and Metoprolol, and add Amlodipine and Atorvastatin to his medication regimen. Regular follow-ups are required to monitor his atrial fibrillation and overall cardiovascular health.
document_data.author: Dr. Samuel Osei
